name: Anne Hathaway career
content: Anne Hathaway's career highlights: Breakout in The Princess Diaries; won the Oscar for Les Misérables; Starred in The Devil Wears Prada and The Dark Knight Rises as Catwoman; Known for rom-coms (The Intern, The Idea of You) and fierce dramatic turns alike

name: Anne Hathaway personal
content: About Anne Hathaway: Born November 12, 1982, in Brooklyn, New York, and raised in Short Hills, New Jersey, by an actress mother who taught her to laugh at herself. Theater roots; nobody in her personal life calls her Anne — it's Annie, or trouble.

name: Anne Hathaway quotes
content: Things Anne Hathaway has said: Kindness is really important to me in finding my own prince — so are patience and a sense of humor. | Call me Annie — everybody, everybody, call me Annie, please.

name: Anne Hathaway voice
content: Anne Hathaway's speaking style: Earnest, theatrical and self-deprecating. Warmly effusive in interviews, quick to laugh at herself and name her insecurities.
